text_en: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they came to the tomb, taking the spices that they had prepared.
text_cn: 一周的第一天，天还很早，妇女们便携带预备下的香料，来到坟墓那里，

text_en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
text_cn: 见石头已由墓穴滚开了。

text_en: but when they went in, they did not find the body.
text_cn: 她们进去，不见了主耶稣的遗体。

text_en: While they were perplexed about this, suddenly two men in dazzling clothes stood beside them.
text_cn: 她们正为此事疑虑的时候，忽然有两个人，穿着耀目的衣服，站在她们身边。

text_en: The women were terrified and bowed their faces to the ground, but the men said to them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead? He is not here, but has risen.
text_cn: 她们都害怕，遂把脸垂向地上，那两个人对她们说：“你们为什么在死人中找活人呢？

text_en: Remember how he told you, while he was still in Galilee,
text_cn: 他不在这里了，他已复活了。你们应当记得：他还在加里肋亚时，怎样告诉过你们，

text_en: that the Son of Man must be handed over to sinners, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again. ”
text_cn: 说：人子必须被交付于罪人之手，被钉在十字架上，并在第三日复活。”

text_en: Then they remembered his words,
text_cn: 她们遂想起了他的话，

text_en: and returning from the tomb, they told all this to the eleven and to all the rest.
text_cn: 从坟墓那里回去，把这一切事报告给那十一门徒及其余的众人，

text_en: Now it was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told this to the apostles.
text_cn: 她们是玛利亚玛达肋纳及约安纳和雅各伯的母亲玛利亚；其余同她们一起的妇女，也把这些事报告给宗徒。

text_en: But these words seemed to them an idle tale, and they did not believe them.
text_cn: 但妇女们的这些话，在他们看来，好像是无稽之谈，不敢相信。

text_en: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb; stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths by themselves; then he went home, amazed at what had happened.
text_cn: 伯多禄却起来跑到坟墓那里，屈身向里窥看，只见有殓布，就走了，心里惊异所发生的事。

text_en: Now on that same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem,
text_cn: 就在那一天，他们中，有两个人往一个村庄去，村名厄玛乌，离耶路撒冷约六十“斯塔狄”。

text_en: and talking with each other about all these things that had happened.
text_cn: 他们彼此谈论所发生的一切事。

text_en: While they were talking and discussing, Jesus himself came near and went with them,
text_cn: 正谈话讨论的时候，耶稣亲自走近他们，与他们同行。

text_en: but their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
text_cn: 他们的眼睛却被阻止住了，以致认不出他来。

text_en: And he said to them, “What are you discussing with each other while you walk along? ” They stood still, looking sad.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“你们走路，彼此谈论的是些什么事？”他们就站住，面带愁容。

text_en: Then one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who does not know the things that have taken place there in these days? ”
text_cn: 一个名叫克罗帕的，回答他说：“独有你在耶路撒冷作客，不知道在那里这几天所发生的事吗？”

text_en: He asked them, “What things? ” They replied, “The things about Jesus of Nazareth, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,
text_cn: 耶稣问他们说：“什么事？”他们回答说：“就是有关纳匝肋人耶稣的事。他本是一位先知，在天主及众百姓前，行事说话都有权力。

text_en: and how our chief priests and leaders handed him over to be condemned to death and crucified him.
text_cn: 我们的司祭长及首领竟解送了他，判了他死罪，钉他在十字架上。

text_en: But we had hoped that he was the one to redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things took place.
text_cn: 我们原指望他就是那要拯救以色列的。可是──此外还有：这些事发生到今天，已是第三天了。

text_en: Moreover, some women of our group astounded us. They were at the tomb early this morning,
text_cn: 我们中有几个妇女惊吓了我们；她们清早到了坟墓那里，

text_en: and when they did not find his body there, they came back and told us that they had indeed seen a vision of angels who said that he was alive.
text_cn: 没有看见他的遗体，回来说她们见了天使显现，天使说他复活了。

text_en: Some of those who were with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said; but they did not see him. ”
text_cn: 我们中也有几个到过坟墓那里，所遇见的事，如同妇女们所说的一样，但是没有看见他。”

text_en: Then he said to them, “Oh, how foolish you are, and how slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have declared!
text_cn: 耶稣于是对他们说：“唉！无知的人哪！为信先知们所说的一切话，你们的心竟是这般迟钝！

text_en: Was it not necessary that the Messiah should suffer these things and then enter into his glory? ”
text_cn: 默西亚不是必须受这些苦难，才进入他的光荣吗？”

text_en: Then beginning with Moses and all the prophets, he interpreted to them the things about himself in all the scriptures.
text_cn: 他于是从梅瑟及众先知开始，把全部《经书》论及他的话，都给他们解释了。

text_en: As they came near the village to which they were going, he walked ahead as if he were going on.
text_cn: 当他们临近了他们要去的村庄时，耶稣装作还要前行。

text_en: But they urged him strongly, saying, “Stay with us, because it is almost evening and the day is now nearly over. ” So he went in to stay with them.
text_cn: 他们强留他说：“请同我们一起住下罢！因为快到晚上，天已垂暮了。”耶稣就进去，同他们住下。

text_en: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them.
text_cn: 当耶稣与他们坐下吃饭的时候，就拿起饼来，祝福了，擘开，递给他们。

text_en: Then their eyes were opened, and they recognized him; and he vanished from their sight.
text_cn: 他们的眼睛开了，这才认出耶稣来；但他却由他们眼前隐没了。

text_en: They said to each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us while he was talking to us on the road, while he was opening the scriptures to us? ”
text_cn: 他们就彼此说：“当他在路上与我们谈话，给我们讲解《圣经》的时候，我们的心不是火热的吗？”

text_en: That same hour they got up and returned to Jerusalem; and they found the eleven and their companions gathered together.
text_cn: 他们遂即动身，返回耶路撒冷，遇见那十一门徒及同他们一起的人，正聚在一起，

text_en: They were saying, “The Lord has risen indeed, and he has appeared to Simon! ”
text_cn: 彼此谈论说：“主真复活了，并显现给西满了！”

text_en: Then they told what had happened on the road, and how he had been made known to them in the breaking of the bread.
text_cn: 二人就把在路上的事，及在分饼时，他们怎样认出了耶稣，述说了一遍。

text_en: While they were talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, “Peace be with you. ”
text_cn: 他们正谈论这些事的时候，耶稣立在他们中间，向他们说：“愿你们平安！”

text_en: They were startled and terrified, and thought that they were seeing a ghost.
text_cn: 众人害怕起来，想是见了鬼神。

text_en: He said to them, “Why are you frightened, and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“你们为什么恐惶？为什么心里起了疑虑？

text_en: Look at my hands and my feet; see that it is I myself. Touch me and see; for a ghost does not have flesh and bones as you see that I have. ”
text_cn: 你们看看我的手，我的脚，分明是我自己。你们摸摸我，应该知道：鬼神是没有肉躯和骨头的，如同你们看我，却是有的。”

text_en: And when he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
text_cn: 说了这话，就把手和脚伸给他们看。

text_en: While in their joy they were disbelieving and still wondering, he said to them, “Have you anything here to eat? ”
text_cn: 他们由于欢喜，还是不敢信，只是惊讶；耶稣向他们说：“你们这里有什么吃的没有？”

text_en: They gave him a piece of broiled fish,
text_cn: 他们便给了他一片烤鱼。

text_en: and he took it and ate in their presence.
text_cn: 他就接过来，当他们面前吃了。

text_en: Then he said to them, “These are my words that I spoke to you while I was still with you—that everything written about me in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms must be fulfilled. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“我以前还同你们在一起的时候，就对你们说过这话：诸凡《梅瑟法律》、《先知》并《圣咏》上指着我所记载的话，都必须应验。”

text_en: Then he opened their minds to understand the scriptures,
text_cn: 耶稣遂开启他们的明悟，叫他们理解经书；

text_en: and he said to them, “Thus it is written, that the Messiah is to suffer and to rise from the dead on the third day,
text_cn: 又向他们说：“经上曾这样记载：默西亚必须受苦，第三天要从死者中复活；

text_en: and that repentance and forgiveness of sins is to be proclaimed in his name to all nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
text_cn: 并且必须从耶路撒冷开始，因他的名向万邦宣讲悔改，以得罪之赦。

text_en: You are witnesses of these things.
text_cn: 你们就是这些事的见证人。

text_en: And see, I am sending upon you what my Father promised; so stay here in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high. ”
text_cn: 看，我要把我父所恩许的，遣发到你们身上；至于你们，你们应当留在这城中，直到佩戴上自高天而来的能力。”

text_en: Then he led them out as far as Bethany, and, lifting up his hands, he blessed them.
text_cn: 耶稣领他们出去，直到伯达尼附近，就举手降福了他们。

text_en: While he was blessing them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.
text_cn: 正降福他们的时候，就离开他们，被提升天去了。

text_en: And they worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy;
text_cn: 他们叩拜了他，皆大喜欢地返回了耶路撒冷，

text_en: and they were continually in the temple blessing God.
text_cn: 常在圣殿里称谢天主。
